summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16, a ControlTitle type (Tuple[ControlType, str]) joined to the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL formatter and Control.title(title). rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, buffering the control only when is_terminal. CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: a console test (forced terminal, skipped on Windows), a control test for Control.title("hello"), and a Windows-only renderer test asserting set_title called once with "Hello, world!". Unverified: tests were not run and Black formatting was not checked. Known risk: LegacyWindowsTerm.set_title asserts titles under 255 characters, which the spec's no-wrapper-exception rule leaves unhandled. Nothing is committed.
